title: Staging Mailpit isolation policy and manual SMTP setup prepared
summary: Fresh read-only audits preserve disabled Auth controls. Seven policy/identity and 18 application email tests pass. Mailpit, network enforcement and Supabase SMTP changes remain unexecuted.

changes.detail: Prepared a nonexecutable Mailpit policy with no forwarding/relay options, required TLS/auth, private UI and external IPv4/IPv6 outbound denial. Added negative synthetic policy and provider identity tests.
Documented exact staging Dashboard setup, costs/dependencies, private credential handling, post-change evidence and separate external approval boundaries. Candidate source and build preserved.

validation.name: Existing application email suppression
